name: three-ws

description: Forge textured 3D models from a prompt, search a free library of CC0 props, rigged characters and motion clips, and browse the models you made on three.ws.
author: three_ws

commands.name: forge-model
commands.title: Forge a 3D Model
commands.subtitle: three.ws

commands.name: search-assets
commands.title: Search 3D Assets
commands.subtitle: three.ws
commands.description: Search free CC0 props, rigged characters and motion clips, then copy embed code or download the file. No account needed.

commands.subtitle: three.ws

preferences.name: apiKey

preferences.title: Quality Tier
preferences.description: Draft is fastest. Standard adds 2K textures. High uses the deepest sampler budget.
